summary: CollPlant Biotechnologies filed a Form 6-K on September 22, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing that Nasdaq confirmed the company regained compliance with Listing Rule 5550(a)(2), the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement. The deficiency notice was received March 23, 2026, and compliance was established over ten consecutive business days from September 4 to September 18, 2026. The matter is formally closed. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction mechanics are disclosed; the filing references the previously completed LightSolver acquisition. Watch for potential future dilution or reverse-split risk if the bid price again falls below $1.00.
